headline: In pursuit of growth

highlights: For the quarter, it reported revenue of INR 57.6bn (+7% YoY) and EBITDA of INR 11.4bn (flat YoY), which led to adj.
Standalone generation grew 16% YoY and power sales were up 8% YoY during the quarter.
In-line print CESC reported consolidated revenues of INR 57bn (+7% YoY), aided by better- than-expected performance at Noida power.
As a result, profit for the quarter was flat YoY at INR 4.4bn.
valuation: We estimate the transaction at ~9x EV/EBITDA, which we believe is on a higher side.

CESC is looking to scale up its RE platform and is targeting 10GW RE capacity in the medium-term; it is progressing well in terms of PPAs, equipment orders for wind capacity and acquiring assets with land and transmission connectivity.
We maintain BUY and revise our SoTP-based target price to INR 176 (from INR 220).
watch: Key risks: 1) Delay in RE capacity addition; and 2) higher build-up of regulatory assets.
The recipient should independently evaluate the investment risks.
